messages:
jess (Sales): Heads-up — Acme's POC is seeing a lot of ECONNRESETs when calling our SDK through their corporate proxy. Happens during larger payloads (long prompts).
acme-sre: Yep — our side sees socket hangups. Happens ~30-60s into some requests. Short requests are fine.
alex (SE): Can you paste a minimal failing request and any proxy logs? Also which SDKs (python/ts) are you using?
acme-sre: Using both: backend is python requests via our service, frontend uses TS node-fetch. We'll attach proxy logs — but they just show connection reset from the proxy to external host.
morgan (Eng): Quick checklist: 1) Are you letting the client use the proxy's connection pooling/keepalive? 2) Is chunked transfer being used? 3) Any TLS MITM that rewrites content-length?
acme-sre: Proxy does SSL-terminate (corporate MITM). It strips TLS but keeps content-length. Not sure about chunked.
bryan (Infra): Our SDKs default to chunked streaming for large responses; some proxies choke on streaming + MITM. Try disabling streaming/chunked encoding on the client to test.
alex (SE): For python try:
```
import requests
s = requests.Session()
s.trust_env = True  # lets env proxy be used
resp = s.post(API_URL, json=payload, timeout=60, proxies={"http": PROXY, "https": PROXY})
```
And set `stream=False` (no chunked) if using SDK streaming flag.
acme-sre: We already set proxies via env, will try disabling stream. Any other socket options?
morgan (Eng): Increase socket timeouts and enable keep-alive on the proxy agent. In Node: set agent keepAlive + maxSockets. Example for TS/node: 
```
const { HttpsProxyAgent } = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent(proxyUrl);
agent.keepAlive = true;
agent.maxSockets = 50;
fetch(API_URL, { agent, timeout: 60000 });
```
Also set `rejectUnauthorized` correctly if MITM cert is installed.
acme-sre: Good call — certs are installed.
jess (Sales): Also asking about SDK retry behavior — do retries re-send large bodies? We need guidance for the customer on safe retry config.
alex (SE): Our retry logic will replay idempotent calls; for non-idempotent large prompt uploads we recommend client-side checks or resumable uploads. For now set conservative `max_retries=2` with exponential backoff and jitter to avoid proxy overload.
morgan (Eng): If you're seeing resets specifically when response size > ~1MB, proxy likely buffering and timing out. Disabling chunked streaming (send as single request) or lowering response size (reduce max tokens) can help.
acme-sre: Trying quick test: disabled streaming and bumped timeout to 90s.
bryan (Infra): Also verify TCP keepalive intervals on their proxy box; short idle timeouts cause resets. If cannot change, try shorter socket keepAlive interval from client.
acme-sre: Ran test — looks better, fewer resets. One still occurred at ~45s. Logs show proxy closed idle connection.
alex (SE): Try setting periodic small keepalive pings or enable 'expect: 100-continue' headers to avoid idle windows. Also set `Connection: keep-alive` explicitly.
morgan (Eng): Another option: switch to direct egress for calls (bypass corporate proxy) for the POC, or put a dedicated egress host that the proxy trusts. That isolates proxy behavior.
acme-sre: Can we change to direct egress for the POC? Security is nervous but ok for trial.
jess (Sales): Customer asked about impact on pricing if we enable direct egress (no change), confirm with finance? Not needed — just normal usage.
acme-sre: Switched to direct egress for a few tests, and ECONNRESETs disappeared. Looks like corporate proxy is the root cause.
alex (SE): For long-term recommend: 1) disable chunked streaming when proxy in path or ensure proxy supports transfer-encoding: chunked; 2) tune keepalive/maxSockets; 3) conservative retry/backoff; 4) if possible, provide proxy whitelist for direct egress.
morgan (Eng): We also shipped a small SDK option in the last patch: `client.config({proxyCompatibilityMode: true})` — it disables streaming and adjusts timeouts automatically.
acme-sre: Tried that and it's green. No resets in 2 hours of tests.
jess (Sales): Awesome — I'll update the POC runbook and slide to note proxyCompatibilityMode for corporate proxies.
deploy-bot: deploy: release v1.12.3 to staging — feature: proxyCompatibilityMode.
jess (Sales): Closing loop with Acme — will follow up next week on GA readiness. Thanks everyone for quick help :thumbsup:
